At the critical moment, Lynn has a stroke of genius—he fakes the success of her experiment and uses his acting skills to deceive her. But this is only a temporary fix, as the original story foretells a tragic ending for her and everyone around her.
Thus begins Lynn’s double life: outwardly pretending to be under hypnosis, while secretly preparing to escape at any moment.
However, things soon take an unexpected turn…
Excerpts from “Princess’s Diary”:
“The experiment succeeded!”
“As the only successful subject, I’ve decided to keep him by my side.”
“The curse mark on my face makes me hideous in the eyes of others, but he told me I’m beautiful.”
“I’m happy because what people say under hypnosis is their true feelings.”
“When we were alone, on a whim, I kissed him.”
“The feeling was strange and made me lose composure, but fortunately, he won’t retain the memory after the hypnosis wears off.”
“So, it’s fine to be a little bolder, right?”
associated_names: 别再催眠我了，反派皇女！

97281.synopsis:

He refused to let me kiss him, hug him, or even sleep in the same bed with him.
Unwilling to give up, I leaned closer to him.
Drip, drip…
This innocent little puppy got a nosebleed.

103681.synopsis:
Lu Ziqing got married at the young age of 23.
No one knew who his spouse was. Despite his carefree and flirtatious nature, Lu Ziqing was always tight-lipped about his private affairs.
That was until one day when the company brought in a high-ranking executive—26-year-old, stern-faced Lin Yu.
Lin Yu was a textbook workaholic, nicknamed the “Disciplinary Director.” He was tireless, decisive, and strict to the point that subordinates instinctively lowered their gazes and held their breaths in his presence.
Even the ever-reckless Lu Ziqing straightened up when facing Lin Yu.
– “Scan the meeting documents and send them to me. Also, print five copies and distribute them to the department heads.”
– “Next week’s training has been moved up by three days. Prepare the schedule and send it to me before the end of the day.”
– “Personal matters are strictly prohibited during work hours. You should know that.”
– “Sorry, Director Lin,” Lu Ziqing admitted obediently. “Next time, I’ll make sure to order takeout only after 11 PM.”
…
Onlookers were stunned—who would’ve thought that the infamous young master Lu could actually be tamed?
What no one knew was that during countless late-night overtime sessions, Lu Ziqing would bring takeout from a restaurant, place it firmly on Lin Yu’s desk, and order, “Eat while it’s hot.”
Lin Yu wouldn’t even look up. “Just leave it there.”
Lu Ziqing insisted, “No, eat it now.”
Lin Yu finally raised his eyes. “Are you giving me orders?”
“Wouldn’t dare,” Lu Ziqing sighed. “But let’s be real, babe—you’re way fiercer now than you were in my arms last night.”
……
One-Line Summary: A flirtatious younger Alpha × a stern and serious older Omega in a “married first, fall in love later” story.
Tags: Arranged Marriage, Comedy, Sweet Romance, ABO Dynamics.

104449.synopsis:
[Hello, Mr. Joo Hee-beom. This is the Korea Ability Association.
As of March 8, 2025, you have been classified as a Guide.] 
At twenty-four, long past his teenage years, Hee-beom suddenly awakens as a Guide.
He isn’t thrilled about his new classification—
And then, appearing before him is I-young, the S-Class Esper who has never had a Guide in his life.
“You’re really my Guide, aren’t you?”
“…My Guide?”
I-young is delighted to have finally found a Guide with a 97% compatibility rate.
But for some unknown reason, Hee-beom keeps rejecting him…
“I’m not doing this. I won’t be a Guide.”
* * *
“Hee-beom-ah, I like you.”
Hee-beom-ah, I like you.
Hee-beom-ah, I like you.
Hee-beom-ah.
I like you.
Hee-beom’s mind blurred.
It felt like his body was floating.
His feet were on the ground, but he couldn’t feel them.
Everything was just… empty. Fuzzy.
Snapping back to his senses, Hee-beom stammered.
“W-what, why are you saying something like that… just from holding hands?”
“Why? What’s wrong with saying I like you?”
“It’s weird!”
I-young tilted his head, as if he was the one who didn’t understand.
“It’d be weirder if I didn’t like you.”
“…….”
“I like you, Hee-beom-ah. So much. More and more, every single day.”

106241.synopsis:
Chen Chang’an transmigrated into a cannon fodder character with the same name in an entertainment circle novel, known in the industry as a “fourth-rate actor.”
“Fourth-rate” refers to – first-rate looks, second-rate fame, third-rate acting skills, and no-rate moral character.
Aiming to become a “model youth,” Chen Chang’an resolved to stop his self-destructive behavior and make his way through genuine ability. Just after making this vow, he found himself trapped in an elevator with the movie emperor male lead for two whole hours.
Jiang Baiqing, who had been repeatedly framed: “Afraid of me? Your cold sweat has already soaked through your clothes.”
Chen Chang’an, pretending to be calm: “It’s a designed see-through effect, this is my new style.”
*
Jiang Baiqing noticed that Chen Chang’an had indeed changed his style. During games, while others fought for chairs, he would give up his seat. When holding a microphone, while others sang love songs, he would burp.
Until one night, Chen Chang’an knocked on Jiang Baiqing’s hotel room door to improve their relationship.
Jiang Baiqing: As the old saying goes, it’s easier to change rivers and mountains than one’s nature. One must not be swayed by beauty.
Still Jiang Baiqing: As the old saying goes, a rope can saw through wood, and dripping water can pierce stone. Falling in love is nothing to be ashamed of.
Chen Chang’an: Well, actually, I just see you as a good brother…
Jiang Baiqing: ?! You’re testing an old cadre with just this level of affection?
associated_names: 扒一扒那位自我攻略的老干部影帝

111361.synopsis:
Lately, Cha Dohyeon has been acting strange. No, it feels like he’s been strange for quite a while now.
“What are we to each other, Eunho?”
“I’m pathetically jacking off to your school uniform. And you, oblivious, are just smiling next to me?”
Born in the same neighborhood, we spent our entire short lives together from elementary school through high school. Cha Dohyeon was that kind of person to me.
Being by his side like family felt natural, and I thought I knew him better than anyone.
So, I never noticed. How Cha Dohyeon looked at me.
Beneath that indifferent expression, even in the sweltering summer heat, what kind of feelings he was hiding.
“If my heart was even a little lighter, you would have been beneath me long ago, covered in my cum.”
“Yeo Eunho, you better draw a clear line this time. If you hate it.”
“Because I won’t fall for it again.”
…But Cha Dohyeon, if you act like this, then I…
What am I supposed to do?

116225.synopsis:
There are still differences even in rebirth.
—— Ye Bufan has been reborn. In his past life, he saved a girl from school bullying. With that opportunity, he took control of both the criminal and righteous worlds, and was ready to marry three beauties. But on the night before his wedding, he got too excited, had a heart attack, and died.
Luckily, he’s been reborn. Looking at the girl being bullied in front of him, he decides to follow the same script and walk the invincible path once more.
—— Yin Tian has also been reborn. In his past life, he was a school tyrant who bullied classmates. By a twist of fate, he was transported to the cultivation world to temper his heart and ended up becoming a righteous leader.
Now reborn back into the modern world, staring at the girl he once bullied, Yin Tian decides to be kind to others and quietly pursue immortality.
—— After waiting for so long, just when Ye Bufan thought the girl had finally fallen deep into bullying and was waiting to be rescued, he discovered that the once pitiful little thing was now tagging along behind Yin Tian like a loyal lackey, all smiles.
An Qing: “Brother Tian, Brother Tian, I finished your homework for you!”
An Qing: “Brother Tian, Brother Tian, here’s your breakfast for today!”
……
An Qing: “Brother Tian, Brother Tian, do you want to eat first, take a shower first, or… eat me first～”

116481.synopsis:
“I have no dreams, I just want to play.”
I live by this motto with my parents’ financial support, until one day.
“The Natrene Empire connected to Earth invites you all.”
I suddenly got possessed into my favorite book, “Majuk.”
A fantasy world where Earth people summoned to the Natrene Empire overnight have to wield swords and magic to save the world. Sure, I loved this book enough to reread it multiple times, but that was when I was reading it comfortably in my warm room. I never wanted to actually get possessed into this harsh place and suffer like this. Talk about a complete disaster.
Anyway, since the main characters are here, world peace shouldn’t be a problem, so I tried to survive safely without getting in their way as they defeat the Demon King… but now I’m in big trouble.
“Are you still afraid of me?” Starting with Lee Jin-sung, the villain of this world.
“Just admit it. Han Ji-woo, you’re the ultimate pushover.” The sub-protagonist who hates me just because I’m supposedly good.
“Can you call me mom?” An extra with zero intelligence who gratefully accepts even bitter medicinal herbs that make your tongue numb.
“I found what I like, Han Ji-woo.” Even the protagonist who, when I told him to live like a human being, decided he wants to fall in love with me.
Too much attention is getting tangled up with me, who just wants to live quietly alone. I don’t need any of this, I just want to live comfortably.

120577.synopsis:
I tried hiring my poor classmate. This maid is a little suspicious!?
Kiyomiya Keiji is the only son of a distinguished, prestigious family. But due to circumstances, he can’t inherit the family, and he was enjoying living alone in a separate residence. One day, the honors student Hisaka Sayaka, who is even respected by her upper-class classmates, shows up at his door in a maid uniform.
“Even I’m not so much of a s*um to hire a classmate with money.”
“If you don’t hire me, a homeless girl in a maid uniform will be born.”
“So I’m s*um even if I refuse!?”
“If you do it now, the ‘service’ you’re hoping for will also be included.”
“…”
“Ah, you wavered a little.”
My sanity can’t handle living under the same roof with a girl I secretly have a crush on!
But what is Sayaka doing, occasionally rummaging through my room?
associated_names: Sukidatta Ko o Meido ni Shitara, Ore no Heya de Kossori Nani ka Shiteiru

123393.synopsis:
When the nine stars align, illusions become reality. Monsters invade the world, bringing devastation and death! Powerful warriors tame these monsters from the Phantom Realm, forming contracts to become Beast Tamers, with mythical beasts becoming humanity’s loyal protectors.
Scorpion-tailed griffins soar through the skies, crimson-scaled hydras dominate the seas, and silver-backed wolves howl at the moon.
But Yun Jin, a newly initiated Beast Tamer, discovers something shocking—her beasts can evolve infinitely!
From a rainbow koi to a five-clawed golden dragon, From a tiny red sparrow to a fiery phoenix, From a flame steed to an Inferno Qilin, From a drunken herb to a bewitching divine flower, Yun Jin constantly defies the impossible.

145921.synopsis:
He started out as the youngest person to pass the press examination. Two years later, he’s now the grim reaper of the entertainment department. Within the broadcasting station, Daham, a star PD, was famous for holding funerals for every program he joined. And finally, on the day his sixth program was cancelled, he picked up a cat while drunk.
But this wasn’t any ordinary cat.
“Me? The devil. You, become my contractor.”
From that day on, Daham’s odd life got even more complicated …
Yes. If it can help me succeed, who cares if it’s not human? Let’s use everything we have.
————-
If the only way to save his job is to turn a devil, an exorcist, and a couple of monsters into idols, Daham will do it. He just never expected each of his soldiers to possess quite this strange a character.

179713.synopsis:
After her mother’s death, Shen Weici is left utterly alone, drifting like a rootless weed. She travels a great distance to the capital to seek out her relatives.
Upon first entering the Marquis’s estate, she treads carefully, facing difficulties at every turn — yet throughout it all she remains quiet and gentle, with no desire to take a single thing from the household. She only wishes to find herself a suitable marriage and a small corner of peace to call her own.
Song Zhang, the capital’s notorious “Lord of Hell,” is a man of noble lineage who holds great power and regards everyone beneath him with contempt.
When he first lays eyes on Shen Weici, he is full of disdain and makes things difficult for her.
Later, he notices her smiling shyly at another man, her beautiful eyes alluring as a fox spirit’s — and he scoffs coldly as he walks away, only to secretly destroy the promising match behind her back.
He watches her face him with reddened eyes, demanding to know why. He answers with a lazy, wicked smile: “Zhang the Second placed first in the imperial exams young and comes from a distinguished family — who do you think you are to cling to him? If you want a peaceful life, why not beg me? I might just grant you the position of honored concubine.”
But the tables turn swiftly. In the end, it is he who kneels at her door, eyes red and pleading:
“Ah Ci… I’m begging you…”
“Don’t carve out my heart…”
He had used every dark means at his disposal for her sake — and only in the end did he realize he had already fallen beyond saving.

192769.synopsis:
